A state attaining the squared C*-norm creates a common eigenvector in its GNS representation; central commutators force alpha times all support-difference determinants to be integers. Conversely isotropy gives commuting Weyl generators whose tracial joint spectral measure has zero nonconstant Fourier moments, hence full Haar support, and the twisted-character phases attain the coefficient l1 sum. Rank-zero, rank-one, rank-two and rational/irrational cases are checked separately. A finite checker passes 4,257 supplementary assertions, not infinite certification.
